_comment: 出厂预制 skill 清单。每个智能体模版创建时自动预填这些 skill（source=preset, builtin=true），开发者可在模版编辑页开关。SKILL.md 本体位于同目录 preset_skills/<name>/。Hermes 0 skill 也能跑，此清单是「开箱即用最小可用集」，非运行时硬需求。

presets.name: plan
presets.description: Plan mode: write an actionable markdown plan to .hermes/plans/, no execution. Bite-sized tasks, exact paths, complete code.
presets.author: Hermes Agent

presets.name: searxng-search
presets.description: Free meta-search via SearXNG — aggregates results from 70+ search engines. Self-hosted or use a public instance. No API key needed.
presets.author: hermes-agent

presets.name: concept-diagrams
presets.description: Generate flat, minimal light/dark-aware SVG diagrams as standalone HTML files. Best suited for educational and non-software visuals.
presets.author: v1k22, ported into hermes-agent

presets.name: fastmcp
presets.description: Build, test, inspect, install, and deploy MCP servers with FastMCP in Python. Use when creating a new MCP server or wrapping an API/database as MCP tools.
presets.author: Hermes Agent

presets.name: one-three-one-rule
presets.description: Structured decision-making framework: one problem statement, three options with pros/cons, one recommendation with definition of done and implementation plan.
presets.author: Willard Moore

presets.name: im-channel-push
presets.description: IM 通道消息推送（出站，支持企微/钉钉/飞书等）。Cron 定时任务/主动提醒场景下向指定 IM 用户推送 markdown/text/卡片消息。通过 terminal 执行 send.py 调 gateway send 端点下发。
presets.author: UnionAgents

presets.name: current-user-info
presets.description: 查询当前用户基本信息（用户名/真实姓名/联系方式/角色/业务身份等）。处理任务需要当前用户自身信息时使用——每次调用返回数据库最新值，不依赖对话记忆。仅查询，不能修改用户信息。
presets.author: UnionAgents
